This is an AI-driven E2E QA automation framework (Playwright + JavaScript).

Before generating code, read these files in order:
1. `.context/global/global-context.md` — app info, selector rules, conventions
2. `.context/skills/framework-architecture.md` — architecture, POM rules, workflows
3. `.context/skills/automation-rules.md` — pre-automation checklist, naming conventions
4. `.context/prompts/pom-generator.md` — when generating Page Objects
5. `.context/prompts/test-generator.md` — when generating test specs

All project knowledge lives in `.context/`. Read the relevant `.md` files before writing any code.
